digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and RUF rule family integration
propositions: Enable the RUF rule family in pyproject.toml global selection and add RUF001, RUF002, RUF003 to the global ignore list to defer intentional Unicode prose and UI content.

Extend tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert that RUF is in [tool.ruff.lint].select, that [tool.ruff.lint].ignore equals exactly [RUF001, RUF002, RUF003], that extend-ignore is absent, and that no per-file-ignores code equals or starts with RUF.

Remediate 179 actionable RUF diagnostics from the live narrow census across src/rebar and tests using safe Ruff fixes and manual resolution, resulting in zero enabled RUF diagnostics outside the three deferred codes.
Remove 374 stale RUF100 noqa suppressions introduced when RUF is enabled under the full configured rule set, ensuring ruff check src tests exits 0.
Verify configuration and remediation via ruff check commands and pytest, ensuring make lint and the default test tier pass without regression.
